items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1970-11-14
items.q: The name 'Harry' appears only in the phrase 'Nick and Harry jumped over the fence' within a general anecdote about racial segregation and social dynamics in Mississippi. There is no indication that the interviewee, Mike De Lay, knew Harry personally or had a direct relationship with him.
